'''Bravo Team''' was a military unit of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] commanded by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Kadriss]]. During the [[Galactic War]] the unit was stationed on [[Voss]], where it was wiped out by [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] cyberbeasts, forcing Kadriss to turn to outsiders for assistance.
